rubric.level_1: Failure is treated as proof of personal defect.
rubric.level_2: Student can sometimes separate failure from identity with support.
rubric.level_3: Student describes failure as data in familiar situations.
rubric.level_4: Student independently uses failure as feedback and chooses a next action.

rubric.level_1: Student believes there is one correct path and they are late.
rubric.level_2: Student can name more than one possible path with support.
rubric.level_3: Student generates multiple futures and one prototype.
rubric.level_4: Student actively tests multiple futures through conversations or experiences.

rubric.level_1: Student sees current state as fixed.
rubric.level_2: Student identifies one designable part of the situation.
rubric.level_3: Student takes small action to change a designable variable.
